Body.Content:
Manage expenses across multiple Business Central companies and environments more efficiently with the Expense Agent web app. Switch between the companies and environments you’re authorized to access within a single session, without restarting the app or signing in again.

Benefits

• Access multiple authorized Business Central environments from the Expense Agent web app.

• Switch directly between companies while managing expenses.

• Reduce context switching when working across multiple organizations, business units, or legal entities.

GA date: April CY2027

Preview date: January CY2027
